definition: the opposite drops the two of us take afterwards, and what we each do about them

settled:
For probably eighty percent of our marriage the two of us crashed in opposite ways after sex. Jen had a strong negative emotional drop. I had a strong physiological drop that made me very sleepy. Two different mechanisms in the same moment.

The remediation came later and is simple on both sides. I have learned to linger and cuddle until she is ready to get up, rather than going straight to sleep. She has learned to eat some chocolate or another treat afterwards for a positive lift.

Both have helped.
